title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Qualifications, Registration, and Election of Delegates)

(1) The qualifications for delegates as defined in Article 8, Paragraph 7 of the Act shall be individuals who are engaged in animal husbandry and have their registered address or place of residence or business within the electoral district at the time of the election announcement.

(2) Individuals intending to be registered as delegates must submit a registration application at a location designated by the animal husbandry association no later than 15 days before the election.

(3) The animal husbandry association must confirm the eligible voters no later than 30 days before the election and announce the date, time, and location of the election, as well as the list of voters and the number of delegates per electoral district.

(4) The animal husbandry association must announce the list of candidates no later than 10 days before the election.

(5) Voting shall be conducted by secret ballot using either a single-candidate ballot or a multiple-candidate ballot, with each voter casting only one vote.

(6) Voting can be conducted in person or by mail or electronic means. However, votes cast by mail or electronic means shall only be considered valid if they are received at the designated receiving address of the animal husbandry association no later than 8:00 PM on election day (electronic means refer to the information entered into the information processing system).

2024.1.25>
⑦ When an agricultural organization elects representatives through direct voting, it must maintain a list of voters at the voting location. <Amended 2024.1.25>
⑧ When an agricultural organization determines a winner according to Article 8(5) of the Act, it must immediately announce the winner's name and location. In this case, the method of announcement shall be in accordance with Article 6. <Amended 2017.1.2>
⑨ In addition to the matters stipulated in paragraphs 1 through 8, any other matters necessary for elections, etc., shall be determined by the relevant agricultural organization's regulations.
